textbookBox.concept: Government plays an important role in our lives. It makes rules, which is the legislative function, carries them out, the executive function, and settles disputes, the judicial function.

textbookBox.concept: In a direct democracy, people take decisions themselves, as the class might do. In a representative democracy, people elect representatives to make laws for them.

beats.en: In a direct democracy, people take decisions themselves, as the class might do. In a representative democracy, people elect representatives to make laws for them.
beats.speakEn: In a direct democracy, people take decisions themselves, as the class might do. In a representative democracy, people elect representatives to make laws for them.

beats.en: In an absolute monarchy the king or queen has complete control over making laws, enforcing them and judging disputes, and the position passes from one generation to the next within the royal family.
